limitations.quote: The final 0 and new 1 form the next prefix 01.
limitations.note: The patch fixed the one-cycle match delay but also changed two exits from the match state to reuse the final zero, enabling overlapping detections that the reference fix does not produce.
The test caught timing errors, but its rolling-history oracle treated overlapping matches as expected, so the exhaustive pass could not flag the extra pulses introduced by the patch.
